text:
devsec-sarah: Quick heads-up — local audit-validator is failing on CI for some customer-facing events. I'm seeing a missing `kms_action` property in a subset of events from private deployments; the golden fixtures for private don't include those flows.

alex_t: Can you paste the repro?

devsec-sarah: Repro: `./tools/audit-validator --fixtures=golden/private/*.json --schema=schema/v2.json` -> error: `Missing required property 'kms_action' at /events/2`

mike_ops: That sounds like the KMS wrapper. We added conditional emission of `kms_action` only for rotate/export flows recently.

jamie: Wait, validator CI passed on main yesterday though. Did the job run a different fixture set?

ci-bot: Jenkins [audit-validator] #528 failed — see logs: https://ci.internal/jenkins/job/audit-validator/528 (console tail: `ValidationError: Missing required property 'kms_action'`)

maria: Possibility: schema drift. IIRC schema v2 used to accept missing `kms_action` for internal ops, but we tightened it for customer-facing audit events last month.

devsec-sarah: Correct — PR #1023 tightened some required fields when we trimmed RBAC event payloads. Tests updated, but golden fixtures weren't regenerated for private/hybrid deployments, so CI didn't exercise that path.

alex_t: Two immediate options: make `kms_action` optional again (backwards-compatible), or update fixtures + make CI stricter so regressions fail fast. I prefer updating fixtures and CI.

mike_ops: Also consider how KMS wrapper emits the field. Should we emit \"kms_action\": null vs omitting? Downstream parsers expect explicit keys for customer audit logs.

jamie: Can we add a lightweight `audit-coverage-check` step that computes coverage between schema-required fields and golden fixtures? If coverage drops below a threshold (99%) fail CI. Nightly would run a fuller coverage diff.

devsec-sarah: Proposed action list:
- regenerate golden fixtures for private and hosted (owner: devsec-sarah)
- add coverage-check to validator CI (owner: alex_t)
- update KMS wrapper to emit explicit `kms_action` default (owner: mike_ops)
- temporary CI gate/block deploys until golden sync done (owner: karen)

karen: I'll file a quick blocker ticket and alert infra + release.

maria: I'll update schema docs and draft a short customer-facing changelog note describing the clarified `kms_action` semantics.

devsec-sarah: I'll open a fixtures PR by EOD and a hotfix for the CI job to fail loudly with a clearer message.

alex_t: Also adding: include a small sample check in the validator that asserts golden fixtures include at least one event per public event-type with all required fields — simple table-driven check.

mike_ops: For KMS integration patch: I'll default to \"kms_action\": \"none\" for non-rotational ops; this keeps type stable for parsers. PR incoming.

devsec-sarah: Sounds good. Thanks all. I'll post PR links here when available.

ci-bot: Created ticket INFRA-3482 (blocker) and linked to https://issues.internal/INFRA-3482

alex_t: thx :thumbsup:

maria: happy to help review fixtures.

karen: pinged release and security on the blocker thread.

(devsec-sarah uploaded 3 files: golden/private/sa-rotation.json, golden/hosted/key-export.json, notes/coverage-plan.md)
